finalText:
Build passes clean now (exit 0, 0 errors). The wall of `WARN DEP0*`/dedupe lines was harmless noise from the bump, but two real regressions were hiding in the link stage:

- `src/core/options.js` — still read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands modules `{ retryCount }`, so it threw on `undefined.toFixed`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the check only handled `true`/`false` and threw otherwise.

Fixed both (read `retryCount`, and treat `undefined` as backoff-disabled). Remaining ~8 warnings in the log are just deprecation noise from the bump, not build blockers.
